title: Azure ExpressRoute Circuit Health

controlTest.positiveScenario: Inject sample events matching UC-4.2.48 SPL; confirm the search returns rows and alert fires.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign traffic without matching markers; confirm UC-4.2.48 search returns zero rows.

dataSources: `index=cloud` sourcetype=`azure:monitor:metric` collected via `Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices` (Azure Monitor metrics); validate ingest with `| stats count by sourcetype`.
spl:
index=cloud sourcetype="azure:monitor:metric" resource_type="microsoft.network/expressroutecircuits"
| table _time userIdentity.arn eventName sourceIPAddress
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.2.48_azure_expressroute_circu_48"
| sort -_time
description: ExpressRoute provides dedicated private connectivity to Azure for large enterprises. Circuit degradation or BGP peer loss causes failover to backup paths or complete connectivity loss to Azure services.
value: Detecting azure expressroute circuit health early reduces mean time to contain cloud incidents, supports audit logging controls, and prevents silent misconfiguration drift across accounts.
implementation: Collect metrics for ExpressRoute circuits: `BgpAvailability` and `ArpAvailability` (should be 100%), `BitsInPerSecond`/`BitsOutPerSecond` for throughput trending. Alert when BGP availability drops below 100% or throughput drops to zero. Track circuit utilization against provisioned bandwidth to plan capacity upgrades.
visualization: Line chart (BGP/ARP availability %), Line chart (throughput), Single value (circuit status).
cimSpl:
| tstats `summariesonly` avg(Performance.cpu_load_percent) as agg_value
  from datamodel=Performance where nodename=Performance.CPU
  by Performance.host span=5m
| sort - agg_value
dataModelAcceleration: Enable data model acceleration for Performance (CPU node).
knownFalsePositives: Short spikes at deploy time, autoscale thrash, or a noisy neighbor on shared hosts can look bad for a few minutes. We require the condition to last across several intervals or clear on its own before we wake someone.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=cloud`.
• Install and configure `Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices` (Azure Monitor metrics) with the modular input for `azure:monitor:metric`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.2.58.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `userIdentity.arn` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Collect metrics for ExpressRoute circuits: `BgpAvailability` and `ArpAvailability` (should be 100%), `BitsInPerSecond`/`BitsOutPerSecond` for throughput trending. Alert when BGP availability drops below 100% or throughput drops to zero. Track circuit utilization against provisioned bandwidth to plan capacity upgrades.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=cloud sourcetype="azure:monitor:metric" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=cloud sourcetype="azure:monitor:metric" resource_type="microsoft.network/expressroutecircuits"
| table _time userIdentity.arn eventName sourceIPAddress
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.2.48_azure_expressroute_circu_48"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `azure:monitor:metric` in `index=cloud` to detect azure expressroute circuit health. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the provider cloud console audit view for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `userIdentity.arn` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_2_48_alert` with severity aligned to `critical` criticality. Dashboard: Line chart (BGP/ARP availability %), Line chart (throughput), Single value (circuit status)..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade `Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices` (Azure Monitor metrics) and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of azure expressroute circuit health so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
